text: Hospital billing desk: charge card 4111 1111 1111 1111 for today's visit and verify the patient's SSN 078-05-1120 before release.

metadata.notes: Scaffold example only. 4111 1111 1111 1111 is the well-known Visa test PAN; 078-05-1120 is the well-known invalid sample SSN. Neither is real personal data.
